Just Dial Ltd. Data Scientist | Full Time | Mar 2023 - Present | Mumbai

 WeCare Query Resolution – RAG + LLM HR Automation

 Built a GenAI-driven query assistant using LangChain, LlamaIndex, and RAG with vector DBs to automate HR query resolution. Achieved 80% first contact resolution within 24 hrs, reducing HR workload by 30%.

 Stack: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Hugging Face, FAISS/Pinecone, SQL, AWS

	Predictive Monitoring System for Mobile API

 Designed ML pipeline forecasting API performance; tested ARIMA, Prophet, Random Forest Regression, LSTM, and Isolation Forest, selecting LSTM + Isolation Forest hybrid (90%+ accuracy). Integrated LLM-based log summaries and dashboards, reducing downtime risk by 30%.

Stack: TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, ARIMA, Prophet, Random Forest Regression, LSTM, Isolation Forest, Ollama, Docker, Grafana

	Auto-Tagging Services with NLP

 Applied NER, BERT embeddings, keyword extraction on reviews and business descriptions to auto-generate service tags. Improved search accuracy and business discoverability by 25%.

 Stack: Hugging Face Transformers (BERT, KeyBERT), Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, SQL

 OCR-to-LLM Contract Intelligence Pipeline

 Extracted business info from scanned PDFs, brochures, and image cards using PaddleOCR + OpenAI GPT API. Improved data enrichment by 10% and validation by 15%.

 Stack: OpenCV, PaddleOCR, OpenAI GPT API, Pandas, Regex, OCR, LLM

 Sentiment Analysis on User Reviews

 Deployed Transformer-based NLP models with LLM summarization to classify reviews as positive, negative, or neutral, improving actionable insights for business decisions.

 Stack: HuggingFace Transformers (DistilBERT, BERT, RoBERTa), OpenAI GPT API, NLP, LLM

	Automated Store Locator Data Extraction

 Designed AI-powered scraping for store data (addresses, contacts, outlets) handling dropdowns, search, map/list layouts, and pop- ups, achieving 70–80% automation and saving 2–3 hours per site.

 Stack: Selenium, BeautifulSoup, OpenAI GPT ,Web Scrapping, Pompt ,Web Crawling
